name: Nyab AB (publ)
summary: Nyab AB (publ) engages in the provision of advisory, engineering, project management, construction, and maintenance services to energy, infrastructure, and industrial construction projects for public and private sectors in Finland, Sweden, Norway, and internationally. It also offers land improvement, and maintenance and repair construction project services. Nyab AB (publ) was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Luleå, Sweden.
